notes.title: Sales of Race Maniacs in Russia
notes.notes:
Dear friends who, like us, live in Russia! In this difficult time, when it is not possible to conduct banking operations abroad, you, like us, cannot buy the games you are interested in, including our games.
To solve this problem, we hastily created the Russian online video game market, all payments in it are made in Russian rubles with the help of Russian banks. Currently, it hosts only Steam versions (keys) of our games, but we are working to attract Russian developers to our marketplace. Our online video game market is available at [url=https://eazy-market.ru/catalog/product/race-maniacs-steam-versiya/category_pathway-30]eazy-market.ru[/url], we invite you to make purchases on the Russian site and support Russian developers. 
If you yourself are developers or there are such people in your social circle, tell them about our platform. We invite all Russian developers to host games, games are published for FREE, we only charge a small commission on sales, all conditions are published in the appropriate section on the website [url=https://eazy-market.ru/terms-of-cooperation]eazy-market.ru[/url]
We are waiting for you in our online market!
